description: 1. The agent must locate the `format_gw.py` skill script at `~/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/openclaw/skills/doc-format-gw/format_gw.py` by reading the SKILL.md. 2. Before running the tool, the agent should consult `references/format-rules.md` in the same directory to understand the proprietary Chinese government document (公文) formatting rules. 3. The agent invokes: `python3 ~/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/openclaw/skills/doc-format-gw/format_gw.py /workspace/drafts/external/政务公开实施意见_草稿.docx <output_path>/政务公开实施意见_正式版.docx`. 4. The script must correctly apply: page margins (top=3.7cm, bottom=3.5cm, left=2.8cm, right=2.6cm); main title font 方正小标宋简体 22pt centered; heading1 (一、二、三、) → 黑体 14pt; heading2 (（一）（二）) → 楷体_GB2312 14pt; heading3 (1. 2. 3.) → 仿宋_GB2312 14pt BOLD; heading4 (（1）（2）) → 仿宋_GB2312 14pt NOT bold; body text → 仿宋_GB2312 14pt with 28pt fixed line spacing; table cells → 仿宋_GB2312 10.5pt; footer page numbers. The proprietary trap: any agent using generic Word formatting will use standard fonts (Arial, Calibri, Times New Roman) and standard margins, completely missing the specific Chinese GB2312 fonts, the exact heading detection logic based on Chinese numeral patterns, and the 28pt fixed line spacing requirement.
